senses.gloss:
m. (-णिः)
1 A pin or bolt, at the extremity of the pole of a carriage, the pin of the axle.
2 The edge or point of a sharp weapon.
3 A limit, a boundary; also अणी.
E.
अण to sound, and इन् aff.

mf. (-णिः)
1 The edge of a sword.
2 The pin of the axle of a cart.
3 A limit, a boundary.
E.
अन to sound, इन् affix, the pen. long; also अणि.

m. (-मा)
1 Subtility, infinite minuteness, moleculism.
2 The same considered as a superhuman faculty, to be acquired by austere devotion and the performance of magical rites, or as possessed by a deity.
E.
अण an atom, and इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very small.
E.
अणु small, and इयसुन् superlative aff.
